meta.name: add-dashboard
meta.description: Add a monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw. Installs @nanoco/nanoclaw-dashboard and a pusher that sends periodic JSON snapshots.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 添加 NanoClaw 监控仪表板，定期推送数据快照。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你管理 NanoClaw 并希望实时观测其状态。
copy.tagline_en: Add a monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw and stream periodic data snapshots.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage a NanoClaw instance and want to watch its metrics on a dashboard.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会往项目里装一个监控面板,每隔约 60 秒把数据库状态和约 2 秒的实时日志推送给面板,并在浏览器里展示群组、会话、消息、用户、Token 用量、上下文窗口等页面。
howto.when: 当用户要求给 NanoClaw 添加监控面板或执行 /add-dashboard 时触发。

say.text: 给 NanoClaw 加上监控面板。
say.note: 按步骤安装依赖并接好代码。

say.text: 装好后生成 DASHBOARD_SECRET 并设置端口。
say.note: 配置环境变量,面板才能启动。

howto.what_en: Adds a local monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw: a pusher sends a JSON snapshot of database state every 60s and tailed log events every 2s; the dashboard serves an Overview, Agent Groups, Sessions, Channels, Messages, Users, and Logs pages in the browser.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to add a monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw or runs /add-dashboard.

say_en.text: Add a monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw.
say_en.note: It installs and wires the dashboard.

say_en.text: Generate DASHBOARD_SECRET and set a port after install.
say_en.note: Configures env vars so the panel starts.
